what: Expected vs actual API responses for the Company, Press Release and Events pages.
probedFrom: local machine, direct curl against the live hosts - no Next.js fetch cache involved, so these are true upstream responses.

definitions.expected: The shape the repo codes against - the TypeScript interface in src/services/, plus the documented assumptions in the surrounding comments.
definitions.actual: A verbatim live capture, with strings over 300 chars truncated and a marker appended. Credentials are redacted.

topFindings.finding: The Events list endpoint now returns 7 upcoming events instead of 839 spanning 2007-2026, and compId is null on all of them.
topFindings.consequence: No live event can show its press releases, and every historical event detail page now 404s. Backend-side; raise with the API team.
topFindings.actionable: confirm intent with the API team before changing code

topFindings.finding: sectors[] elements are keyed `name`; buildIndustry() reads `sectorName`.
topFindings.consequence: The Industry row is blank on every company page that has no curated entry. The data is present and correct - the read looks at the wrong key.
topFindings.actionable: FIXABLE IN THE FRONTEND TODAY - one line in src/services/company-profile.ts

topFindings.finding: GET /api/Companies/{id} returns plaintext `username` and `password` on an unauthenticated endpoint.
topFindings.consequence: Credential disclosure to anyone who can reach the API. Re-confirmed live on 2026-09-10.
topFindings.actionable: backend fix required - strip from the Companies DTO

topFindings.finding: The adapter keeps only companies[0]; co-issued releases return 2+ companies.
topFindings.consequence: Joint announcements credit only the first issuer (e.g. article 109894 drops NEC).
topFindings.actionable: FIXABLE IN THE FRONTEND TODAY - src/services/acn-adapter.ts

topFindings.finding: The new API now returns `language` ("EN", "ZH-TW"), the field the 503 legacy call exists to supply.
topFindings.consequence: Verified to resolve correctly through src/lib/languages.ts. The legacy enrichment call could likely be dropped.
topFindings.actionable: FIXABLE IN THE FRONTEND - removes one dead HTTP call per article render

topFindings.finding: by-company DOES return `language`, contradicting the code comment saying it does not.
topFindings.consequence: Language tags are suppressed on every company feed row despite the data arriving.
topFindings.actionable: FIXABLE IN THE FRONTEND TODAY - one line in src/services/company-articles.ts

topFindings.finding: /api/Companies/{id} already returns the six social links that /details is fetched for.
topFindings.consequence: One redundant HTTP request per company page render.

topFindings.finding: /api/Events/{id} still 500s with the EF Core Companies-column error, unchanged since 2026-09-07.
topFindings.consequence: The list-and-filter workaround in fetchEvent() is still required.
